product_title: Sovereign Art Sync: Zero-Bloat Local Asset Synchronizer
short_description: Decouple heavy binary .uasset files from Git source control with 1-click in-editor sync and auto-discovery in Unreal Engine 5.
long_description: Sovereign Art Sync solves repository bloat in Unreal Engine 5 projects. It decouples heavy binary .uasset files (meshes, high-res textures, materials, audio) from Git source control while preserving level layouts, C++ source code, and Blueprint DNA. Includes an Editor Utility Widget (EUW) for 1-click in-editor synchronization and auto-discovery.
author: Daniel Acourt
